cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Mum, we signed the lease. Say it's good news before I open the wine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission to move in with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I know. I still want my mother to be pleased.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you toast both of us? I want to remember you welcoming our home, not just tolerating my address.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood ritual of adult approval and keeps seeking emotionally meaningful blessing after B explains permission is unnecessary.
confusable: D52 seeks public protective endorsement; D76 wants someone important personally to be pleased.
comparison: Father and museum departure versus mother and shared-home lease.
seedUse: Preserve the tools-for-success and inclusive toast as B-induced expressions of wanted approval.
